prompt:
The multicolumn section in sections/multicolumn-defaults.liquid currently prints merchant values as-is. Empty settings produce empty headings, an empty data-columns attribute and blank buttons. Add fallback (default) values and edge-case handling as described below. Keep the existing {% schema %} block byte-for-byte. Inputs (all under `section`): - section.settings.title: string or null. - section.settings.columns_desktop: integer or null. - section.settings.button_label: string or null. - section.blocks: array (possibly empty). Each block is an object with `type` (always "column") and `settings`, which has: - heading: string or null - text: string or null - link: string or null "Blank" below means null, an empty string, or a string that contains only whitespace. Every printed string value is trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace and HTML-escaped. This applies to the href value as well. Output: a single line with no whitespace between tags. 1. Always open with `

TITLE

`. TITLE is the trimmed title, or `Our highlights` when the title is blank. 2. If section.blocks is empty, output `

No columns yet

` and no list. Otherwise output `
    `, then one item per block in order, then `
`. N is derived from columns_desktop: - null gives 3. - Values below 1 become 1. - Values above 4 become 4. - Any other value is used as-is. 3. Each item is `

  • HEADING

    `, then the optional parts below, then `
    • `. - HEADING is the trimmed heading. If the heading is blank, use `Column K`, where K is the block's 1-based position. - If the trimmed text is not blank, add `

    TEXT

    `. - If the trimmed link is not blank, add `LABEL`. LABEL is the trimmed button_label, or `Learn more` when button_label is blank. 4. Close with `
    `. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/multicolumn-defaults.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
